visualCharacteristics.purpose: web form with text inputs, selects, checkboxes and a submit button

contentPattern.structure: either a link to a form definition sheet (.json: Name, Label, Type, Options, Mandatory, Placeholder, Value, Help) or rows of Label | Type | Options | Mandatory | Placeholder; plus optional Action, Submit and Success rows and free text rows

reuseGuidance: Use for forms that POST JSON to an endpoint. reCAPTCHA is not built in; add it at the endpoint or as a later enhancement.
